verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Wise publishes a live llms.txt at docs.wise.com, with an agent-oriented summary of the Wise Platform payments API. API reference pages are also served as raw .md URLs (e.g. /api-reference/3ds.md, /api-reference/card-order.md), which an agent can ingest directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing agent/LLM usage of these files, evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt-style corpus, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
